role: Base of every chunk-scoped generator (caves, ravines, Nether caves, and through MapGenStructure every structure type): func_151539_a seeds a Random from the world seed and calls func_151538_a for each chunk within range 8, each with its own derived seed.
scope_reason: Drives caves, ravines and structure start placement in every generated chunk.

members.name: range
members.note: A constant 8 in every C walker.

members.name: rand
members.note: A local jrand in C: vanilla reseeds it at every call, so no state carries between calls. populate.c precomputes the two placement longs once per world (mul_x, mul_z).

members.name: worldObj
members.note: Only used for getSeed and biome lookups; C passes the seed and biome array explicitly.

members.name: func_151539_a
members.note: Also csrc/engine/nether.c:nether_caves (Nether caves) and csrc/engine/populate.c:populate_offer_chunk (the four overworld structure maps).

members.name: func_151538_a
members.note: Empty hook; each subclass's override is indexed in its own record (cave_source, ravine_source, hell_source).

notes: The x-outer, z-inner candidate order and the seed formula (x*k1 ^ z*k2 ^ seed) are reproduced in carve_pass, nether_caves and populate_offer_chunk. Gates not re-run for this record.
